verdict.rationale: Channel3 sits in the agentic-commerce flow, so a merchant could fairly ask what it costs to sell through it. The axis applies. The evidence publishes only developer-side API credit pricing ($0.007 per credit, 1,000 free monthly) and an unspecified percentage of each sale paid to developers. Neither is a published fee schedule for merchants on agent-originated transactions, and both are adjacent, developer-facing pricing that does not answer this story.
